commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install verified runtime and configure every detected supported agent by default; --choose-agents opens the optional interactive selector. Report protected conflicts per agent.

commands.name: doctor
commands.purpose: Read-only installer, runtime/browser and optional setup diagnostics.

commands.name: open
commands.purpose: Forward to Node human Open by current Card ID, not a capsule path; Developer access applies.

commands.name: access
commands.purpose: Open private human-only trial, purchase or recovery screen; no activation by merely opening.

commands.name: browser-install
commands.purpose: Offer a separate pinned browser download; require explicit digest confirmation.

commands.name: update
commands.purpose: Explicit signed compatible update; preserve pins, consent and running tasks.

commands.name: updates
commands.purpose: Manage policy. Auto needs --consent; channel needs --confirm; retry and pin need exact manifest digest.

commands.name: repair-launcher
commands.purpose: Repair owned launcher explicitly and retain changed-file backup.

commands.name: rollback
commands.purpose: Select an eligible verified previous generation, preserve data and task safety.

commands.name: uninstall
commands.purpose: Remove only unchanged owned agent setup; preserve Cards, protected data and verified cache.

commands.name: task-start
commands.purpose: Legacy controlled-launcher task start; stdin JSON.

commands.name: task-tools
commands.purpose: Read allowed tools for existing task; stdin JSON.

commands.name: task-close
commands.purpose: Close exact owned task; stdin JSON.
